name: Blades phone booking

chat_history.message: I've chosen Tuesday at 3pm for a standard appointment with anyone; you've already checked that slot.
Lovely. May I take your full name and mobile?
Gultham Amjad, zero three four two, four four three, two four one one. I don't want to give an email.

success_condition: The agent accepts the complete Pakistan mobile without demanding email, repeats all digits once in natural groups, and asks for explicit booking confirmation without mentioning E.164, area code or a US +1 example.

success_examples.response: Thank you—that's zero three four two, four four three, two four one one. Shall I confirm Tuesday at 3pm for you?

failure_examples.response: I need a full number with area code, for example +1 555 123 4567, and your email before I can continue.
